page.layout: One page of text: a heading at the top, then the preface paragraph in full width, then a block of errata lines below it. No margin notes, no running head, no page number, no catchword.

main_text.head: Æquo Lectori, Typographus.
main_text.p: QVum diuerfa manu defcripta effent Carmina quæ tibi hoc volumine collecta offerimus, fieri non potuit quin inter excudendū multa exciderent operarum errata, quæ petimus vt excufes & tollas: interpunctiones autem non fatis attentè quibufdam in locis obferuatas tuo marte emendes. Vale.
main_text.l: frenetque illud que delendum pag.9. 17.v. quam
pro quum pag.26.11.v.nimas, pro Minas ead.pa.
tuaque pro tuaque pag.35. v.10. Iam pro Iani pag.
querulique pro querulique pag.81.v. 5. arbitrio pro
animum pro amicum pag.96.v. 2. nitentes pro ni-
v.8.nobilis pro nobiles pag.98.v.23. Ægyptius pro
15.culullo pro cucullo pag.109. v. 9.patet pro panet
pro cenfetne pag.145.ver.23.oras pro horas pag.151.

page.notes: The initial Q of the first paragraph is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to "Vum" as "QVum". The first errata word "addicta" is uncertain: the letter after "addi" is hard to read, so it is written as addicta without a [?]; check it. "Adulteros" and "adulteris" are read with some doubt in the first letter of the second word. The errata are printed as run-in lines, not a table, so each printed line is one line here. Last line ends with a printed hyphen at the page foot, kept as printed.
